nvitk.morphology.mst_bridge
===========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.morphology.mst_bridge

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   MST-based bridging of nearby connected components (binary / multilabel).

   Builds a complete graph of components with edge weights = nearest-voxel
   distance, takes a minimum spanning tree (MST), and draws short tubes along
   MST edges shorter than ``max_gap``. Useful for reconnecting fragmented
   vessel masks without a global morphological close.

   :type:  int
   :value: 2

.. py:function:: draw_tube_3d(shape: tuple[int, Ellipsis], p0: numpy.ndarray | Sequence[float], p1: numpy.ndarray | Sequence[float], *, radius: int = 1) -> numpy.ndarray

   Binary mask of a thick 3-D line segment from *p0* to *p1*.


.. py:function:: bridge_binary_components_mst(mask: numpy.ndarray | Any, *, max_gap: int = DEFAULT_BRIDGE_MAX_GAP, tube_radius: int = DEFAULT_BRIDGE_RADIUS) -> numpy.ndarray

   Connect nearby CCs of a binary mask with short tubes (MST of min distances).

   :param mask: Binary volume.
   :param max_gap: Maximum nearest-voxel distance (voxels) for an MST edge to be drawn.
   :param tube_radius: Dilation radius of each bridge polyline.

   :returns: Boolean mask with bridges OR-ed into the original foreground.
   :rtype: np.ndarray


.. py:function:: fill_multilabel_gaps_mst(labels: numpy.ndarray | Any, *, close_radius: int = DEFAULT_CLOSE_RADIUS, bridge_max_gap: int = DEFAULT_BRIDGE_MAX_GAP, bridge_radius: int = DEFAULT_BRIDGE_RADIUS, label_ids: Sequence[int] | None = None) -> numpy.ndarray

   Per-label close + MST CC bridging; never overwrite other label ids.

   :param labels: Integer label volume (``0`` = background).
   :param close_radius: Morphological close footprint radius before bridging (``0`` disables).
   :param bridge_max_gap: Passed to :func:`bridge_binary_components_mst`.
   :param bridge_radius: Passed to :func:`bridge_binary_components_mst`.
   :param label_ids: Labels to process; default = all positive ids present in *labels*.
